primaryNavigation: All 288 primary outcomes remain valid; their existing browser MutationObserver/two-frame timestamps do not use locator polling as the clock.
supplement: All 96 original supplemental outcomes are retained. Their automation elapsed time includes Playwright locator polling/backoff and action dispatch, so it is not used as click-to-useful-content latency. Request counts, bytes and server observations remain valid.
repeat: Repeat the complete 96-outcome supplementary BA/AB set with the same frozen builds and records, using browser click/input -> MutationObserver predicate -> two animation frames timestamps. No individual rows replaced, no application changes or artificial delay.
